project_type: Fullstack monorepo - Python/FastAPI backend, React/Vite frontend, Cloudflare Worker edge proxy
test_framework: pytest with httpx AsyncClient (backend), Playwright + vitest (frontend e2e/unit), vitest (edge unit)
test_command: cd apps/backend && pytest tests/ ; cd apps/frontend && pnpm test:e2e
verification_instructions: 1. Install backend deps: pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt 2. Install frontend deps: cd apps/frontend && pnpm install 3. Install Playwright browsers: npx playwright install chromium 4. Run backend tests: cd apps/backend && pytest tests/ 5. Run frontend e2e: cd apps/frontend && pnpm test:e2e
setup_instructions: 1. pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt -r apps/backend/requirements-dev.in 2. cd apps/frontend && pnpm install 3. npx playwright install chromium --with-deps
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No MongoDB or Redis available locally - backend tests mock DB via patches. Frontend e2e uses Playwright with route mocking. Python 3.11, Node 22, pnpm available.
contribution_requirements: Private repo. Tests must pass without external services (MongoDB, Redis). Backend uses conftest.py patches to mock Beanie/MongoDB. Frontend e2e mocks API routes.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI app factory in app/main.py, Beanie ODM for MongoDB, conftest.py patches User.find_one and rate limiting. Frontend e2e: Playwright with page.route() mocking API responses. Content flow: frontend calls /api/v1/content/library-bundle via apiClient() (axios), backend queries Board/Class/Stream/Subject/Chapter Beanie documents. Auth: JWT HS256/RS256 via app/api/v1/auth.py create_access_token(). Edge: Cloudflare Worker proxies to backend, verifies JWT, rate limits.
directory_structure: apps/backend/ - Python FastAPI with Beanie ODM (MongoDB), apps/frontend/ - React+Vite SPA with Playwright e2e, apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Worker (TS) proxying to backend. Root uses pnpm workspaces.
